Class CLImageDesc

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<CLImageDesc>
org.lwjgl.opencl.CLImageDesc
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
@NativeType("struct cl_image_desc") public class CLImageDesc extends Struct<CLImageDesc> implements NativeResource
struct cl_image_desc {
    cl_mem_object_type image_type;
    size_t image_width;
    size_t image_height;
    size_t image_depth;
    size_t image_array_size;
    size_t image_row_pitch;
    size_t image_slice_pitch;
    cl_uint num_mip_levels;
    cl_uint num_samples;
    union {
        cl_mem buffer;
        cl_mem mem_object;
    };
}
